title: Elimination Free-Throw Contest
description: Players take turns shooting free throws; anyone who misses is eliminated, building pressure shooting in a simple, repeatable format.

content.objective: Build composure shooting free throws under direct elimination pressure.
content.setup: Players form a line behind the free-throw line, taking turns one shot at a time.
instructions: Each player takes one free throw per turn, in order.
Any player who misses is eliminated from that round.
Continue rounds until only one player remains.
Run several rounds so every player gets multiple chances to compete.
coachingPoints: Use the same pre-shot routine every single attempt, under pressure or not.
Stay relaxed; tension late in the contest often causes rushed misses.
Support eliminated teammates positively rather than letting frustration build.
commonMistakes: Rushing the routine once the pressure of elimination sets in.
Changing mechanics mid-contest instead of trusting the usual routine.
Playing carelessly in a round that feels less important.
content.safety: Keep the line organised so only one shooter is at the line at a time.
